description: Agent Automotive: submit a vehicle lease as printed with the vehicle record and the payment schedule: the lease with the lessor, lessee, VIN, model year, make, model, currency, start day, term in months, number of payments, monthly payment, total of payments, yearly and total mileage allowance and its unit; optionally the vehicle record with the VIN, year, make and model; and optionally the payment schedule with its currency and each payment with its id, day due and amount. The signed report gives the lease, the vehicle leased against the record, the term with its end day and the payments due outside it, the mileage allowance with the total figured from the yearly allowance over the term, and the payments with their count, the amounts unlike the monthly payment and the scheduled total against the printed total, and counts them, and names a divergent lease: another VIN or vehicle than the record, a payment count, amount or total unlike the schedule, a payment due after the term ends, and a total mileage allowance that is not the yearly allowance over the term; then a payment due before the lease starts, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No vehicle record, no VIN, no payment schedule, no term or no monthly payment leaves the lease unverified. The term runs whole months from the start day and amounts compare to the cent. This reads a vehicle lease for one VIN: wever_realty-lease-check reads a property lease against the summary given to the principal, and wever_contract-brief states the parties, term, renewal and payment terms of a contract excerpt, while the lease check reads the term, mileage allowance and payments against the vehicle record and the schedule. Verdict auto_lease_divergent, auto_lease_partial, auto_lease_unverified or auto_lease_consistent. POST /api/auto-lease-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.
